Most people think of AI as a Tool.

I have started thinking of it as something else entirely:

A third thought partner.

We each have two inner voices—Lefty (logic) and Righty (intuition).

AI does not replace either. It dances with both.

Sometimes twirling one, sometimes guiding both at once.

This post is a meditation on that idea.

On how AI might not automate our thinking—but help us orchestrate it.

May I cut in?
